title: Voice Typing in Google Docs on Mac: Setup, 6 Fixes, and Dictation in Any App | Lynkk

lines: Google Docs voice typing stops mid-sentence, or the option isn't there at all.
Here's how to set it up, fix it, and dictate in any app on your Mac.
Go to Tools, then Voice typing, or press Command Shift S.
Click the mic and start talking.
Voice typing doesn't add punctuation for you.
Say it out loud: comma, period, new line.
Use Chrome. Allow the microphone for Chrome in your Mac's Privacy and Security settings, and in Chrome's site settings.
Pick the right input under Sound. Stay in the doc, because clicking away stops it. And check the language and your connection.
Docs voice typing only works inside Google Docs, in Chrome.
Lynkk for Mac works in any app. Hold the fn key, talk, and let go. The words land where your cursor is.
The notch shows it's listening, and which app the words go to.
Instant mode runs on your Mac, in English, on the free plan.
Accurate and Polished use the cloud, with 18 languages, on Pro. Only Polished removes the ums and false starts.
And it won't listen in a password field.
Hold fn, talk, and let go, in any app.
